title: US Scott# J61 1c Postage Due Used Los Angeles, CA

descriptionText: The US Scott# J61 1c Postage Due stamp was used in Los Angeles, California. This particular stamp has a denomination of 1 cent and is from the United States. It is of ungraded quality and has not been certified. This stamp falls under the category of US back of book stamps, specifically other US back of book stamps.
